name: Doublewrite Buffer 优化诊断
description: Doublewrite Buffer 是 InnoDB 防止部分页写入（partial page write）导致数据损坏的安全机制。InnoDB 页大小 16KB，但文件系统和磁盘的原子写入通常只有 512B-4KB，如果写入过程中发生崩溃，页可能处于半写状态。Doublewrite 先将页写入一个连续区域（doublewrite buffer），fsync 后再写入实际位置。这带来 2x 写放大。在支持原子写入的存储（某些 SSD 和文件系统）上可以安全关闭以提升写入性能。

signals.desc: 通过 doublewrite 写入的页数
IO 写入放大，doublewrite 是主要贡献者

conditions.desc: 写入性能优化评估时考虑 doublewrite 开销

skip_when.desc: HDD 存储或不确定存储原子写入能力时不要关闭 doublewrite

root_causes.name: Doublewrite 导致写放大影响性能
root_causes.desc: 每次脏页刷写都要先写 doublewrite buffer 再写实际位置，产生 2x 写放大。在高写入负载下，这显著消耗 IO 带宽。SSD 寿命也受写放大影响。

root_causes.name: Doublewrite 被错误关闭导致数据损坏风险
root_causes.desc: 在不支持原子写入的存储上关闭 doublewrite，崩溃后可能出现页损坏（checksum 校验失败）。恢复代价极高。某些云存储声称原子写入但实际实现有 bug。

root_causes.name: 8.0 的 doublewrite 文件位置不当
root_causes.desc: 8.0.20+ 将 doublewrite buffer 从系统表空间移到独立文件（#ib_16384_0.dblwr, #ib_16384_1.dblwr）。可以通过 innodb_doublewrite_dir 指定到不同磁盘分散 IO，但默认在 datadir 与数据文件争抢 IO。

root_causes.name: innodb_doublewrite_pages 配置不优
root_causes.desc: 8.0.20+ 新增 innodb_doublewrite_pages 控制每次 doublewrite 批次大小（默认等于 innodb_write_io_threads）和 innodb_doublewrite_batch_size。调优可减少 fsync 次数。

step1_doublewrite_stats.sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE + 0 FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_dblwr_writes') / GREATEST((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE + 0 FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_pages_written'), 1) * 100, 1) AS doublewrite_overhead_pct

step2_doublewrite_config.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('innodb_doublewrite', 'innodb_doublewrite_dir', 'innodb_doublewrite_pages', 'innodb_doublewrite_batch_size')

step3_write_io_stats.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_data_writes', 'Innodb_data_written', 'Innodb_pages_written', 'Innodb_data_fsyncs')

step4_write_amplification.sql: SELECT dw.v AS dblwr_writes, pw.v AS pages_written, ROUND(dw.v / GREATEST(pw.v, 1), 2) AS dblwr_ratio FROM (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE+0 AS v FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_dblwr_writes') dw, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE+0 AS v FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_pages_written') pw

step2_my_024_detail.sql: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'innodb_doublewrite') AS dw_enabled, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE + 0 FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_data_fsyncs') AS total_fsyncs

version_specific_notes.5.7: innodb_doublewrite 只能在 my.cnf 中设置，需重启。Doublewrite buffer 在系统表空间 ibdata1 中。无法自定义位置
version_specific_notes.8.0: 8.0.20+ 将 doublewrite 移到独立文件。新增 innodb_doublewrite_dir 自定义路径。新增 innodb_doublewrite_pages 和 innodb_doublewrite_batch_size 调优参数。8.0.30+ innodb_doublewrite 支持 DETECT_AND_RECOVER 和 DETECT_ONLY 两种模式
version_specific_notes.8.4: Doublewrite 性能进一步优化。对 NVMe 存储的原子写入检测改进
